name: GEN DIGITAL INC
summary: GEN DIGITAL INC is a global company focused on providing digital safety solutions for consumers. Formerly known as NortonLifeLock, the company is headquartered in Tempe, Arizona, and offers a range of cybersecurity and privacy products and services under brands such as Norton, Avast, LifeLock, Avira, AVG, CCleaner, and ReputationDefender. Gen aims to protect consumers' devices, data, online identity, and home and family needs.
